title: Failed sign-ins and password spray detection in Entra ID sign-in logs
summary: Summarises failed Entra ID sign-ins per source IP and per user, ranks likely password spray (many users, few tries each) against brute force (one user, many tries), and filters out interrupt codes.

title: Impossible travel detection with geo_distance_2points on Entra ID sign-ins
summary: Compares each successful sign-in with the previous one of the same user, computes distance and implied speed, and lists user pairs of sign-ins that no airplane could explain.

title: Find users and apps signing in with single-factor authentication
summary: Lists successful interactive sign-ins that used only a password, ranks users and apps by exposure and shows which Conditional Access result applied, to close MFA gaps before enforcing policies.

title: Service principal credential changes and sign-ins from new IP addresses
summary: Detects new secrets or certificates added to app registrations and service principals and then checks whether those apps signed in from IP addresses never seen in the baseline period.

title: Azure Resource Graph: find resources missing required governance tags
summary: Azure Resource Graph query that lists resources without the tags Owner, CostCenter and Environment, shows which tag is missing and summarises the gap per subscription and resource type.

title: Detect VMs and servers that stopped sending heartbeats with availability percentage
summary: Uses the Heartbeat table to list machines silent for more than a threshold, computes 24-hour agent availability per computer and charts missing minutes to spot flapping or decommissioned servers.

title: CPU and memory pressure per server with percentiles from the Perf table
summary: Builds a capacity report from Perf counters: average, p95 and p99 CPU and memory use per machine, share of time above 90 percent, and a time chart for the busiest servers.

title: Suspicious inbox rules in Exchange Online audit logs (forwarding, deleting, hiding)
summary: Parses OfficeActivity inbox rule operations, extracts rule parameters with mv-apply and flags external forwarding, delete-on-arrival and rules that hide security or finance mails, a typical BEC persistence trick.

title: Hunt encoded PowerShell commands with decoding in Defender Advanced Hunting
summary: Advanced Hunting query for DeviceProcessEvents that finds PowerShell launched with encoded commands, decodes the Base64 UTF-16 payload and flags download cradles, bypass flags and rare parents.

title: Brute force followed by successful logon on Windows servers (Event 4625 then 4624)
summary: Correlates many failed network or RDP logons (4625) with a later successful logon (4624) from the same IP and account within a time window, a classic sign of a successful password guessing attack.
